title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：未成立

title.zh: 泛星系贸易市场：未成立

texts.zh:
很不幸，我们发起的建立泛星系贸易市场的动议碰壁了。虽然我们明显成功地为该计划调动了政治意愿，但却没收到任何有效的主办地提名。

原则上，商业说客和政治拥趸都支持这个想法，并发誓会加倍努力，只要[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]希望再次尝试。
texts.en:
Our motion to bring forth a new Galactic Market has unfortunately failed. While we clearly succeeded in mustering the political will for such a scheme, it did not receive any valid nominations for a host site.

Commercial lobbyists and political proponents alike stand by the idea in principle, having vowed to redouble their efforts should the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] wish to try again.
